enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Turns to back. Remains still. Stretches legs. Turns to left side. Remains still. Turns to right side. Remains still.

Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and cereal. Places on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and spoon. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Puts milk back. Closes refrigerator. Sits at table. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Stands up. Picks up bowl and spoon. Walks to sink. Rinses bowl and spoon. Places in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Takes out socks. Takes out shoes. Closes wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to mirror. Combs hair. Applies deodorant. Puts on watch. Picks up bag. Checks phone. Walks out of bedroom.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Pulls cord. Exits bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital.

Walks to locker room. Changes into scrubs. Puts on gloves. Walks to nurse station. Picks up patient chart. Reads chart. Walks to patient room. Knocks on door. Enters. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Records data. Administers medication. Adjusts IV drip. Talks to patient. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Walks to nurse station. Uses computer.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Talks to colleague. Finishes eating. Returns tray. Walks outside. Walks back to hospital.

Walks to patient room. Checks patient. Administers medication. Talks to patient. Walks to nurse station. Updates records. Uses computer. Answers phone. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Walks to patient room. Checks vital signs. Records data. Talks to patient. Walks to nurse station. Uses computer.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Pulls cord. Exits bus. Walks home. Enters home.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Places on counter. Takes out pot. Fills pot with water. Places on stove. Turns on stove. Chops vegetables. Adds to pot. Stirs. Adds seasoning. Turns off stove. Serves food onto plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Picks up plate and rinses. Places in dishwasher.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Adjusts volume. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Drinks. Puts down drink. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Changes channel.

Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Clicks. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Continues typing. Stands up. Stretches. Sits down. Watches TV. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Clicks. Watches TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Turns off tap. Dries face. Applies moisturizer. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or using phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Puts down book. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls. Taps. Puts down phone. Lies down.

Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Turns to back. Remains still. Stretches legs. Turns to left side. Remains still.
